descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 25 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your room is the farm.

HOME FARM is a cozy mixed reality farming and factory game for Meta Quest. Place your chest, build fields right on your floor and watch wheat, corn, peas, potatoes and beetroot grow in your real room.

FARM WITH YOUR HANDS
Swing a scythe, pull root crops by hand, break rocks with a pickaxe and crank water from your own well to make your fields grow faster.

DEFEND YOUR HARVEST
Sneaky gnomes steal your crops and snails munch your lettuce. Catch them, trap them – or sell a gnome as a pet!

FROM FIELD TO FACTORY
Draw conveyor belts across your floor, smelt ore in the furnace, make bioplastic in the lab, 3D-print casings and build motors and robots.

SELL TO CUSTOMERS
Customers walk right into your room. Serve them at the register, earn coins, level up and unlock new crops, machines and greenhouses.

MULTIPLAYER IN YOUR OWN ROOM
Play together with a friend in the same room and build one farm side by side.

• True mixed reality – your room becomes the game board
• Local multiplayer in the same room
• Comfort mode: everything at table height
• 11 languages · 3 save slots
